name: @sos-2/api-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Typed API Boundary (Work Order P2): the request/response contract vocabulary for the live API surface — typed error envelopes (UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, CONFLICT/stale-revision, DUPLICATE/replayed, NOT_FOUND, INVALID), record write outcomes, pagination cursors, revision headers, observation event ingestion payloads, provider-health payloads and coordination-degradation records. PURE TYPES + GUARDS with ZERO runtime dependencies: this package imports nothing, so the production web console (P1), the API service (apps/api) and the live store (@sos-2/live-store) can all share one boundary contract without dragging storage or domain code along. Semantic payloads (Mission, SystemState, Evidence, ...) cross this boundary as validated JSON preserved verbatim — their semantic types and guards remain owned by the frozen domain packages; this package defines no second semantic registry (AGENTS.md section 4).
